entities.summary: Günther Herrmann was a functionary in the SS of Nazi Germany during World War II and a convicted criminal. He commanded the Sonderkommando 4b and the Einsatzkommando 12 of the Einsatzgruppe C in the occupied Soviet Union and the Einsatzgruppe E in Croatia. In 1973, Herrmann was convicted of the murders committed in 1941–42 in the occupied Soviet Union and was sentenced to seven years in prison.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Günther Herrmann was a functionary in the SS of Nazi Germany during World War II and a convicted criminal. He commanded the Sonderkommando 4b and the Einsatzkommando 12 of the Einsatzgruppe C in the occupied Soviet Union and the Einsatzgruppe E in Croatia. In 1973, Herrmann was convicted of the murders committed in 1941–42 in the occupied Soviet Union and was sentenced to seven years in prison.
